data.answer: QZense Labs Private Limited is a private limited company incorporated on May 23, 2019, in India, registered at Registrar of Companies, ROC Bangalore. It is active and provides IoT solutions for food quality assessment and management. The company has raised a total funding of $966K over 4 rounds, with its latest funding round being a Seed round in 2021. It has 24 institutional investors and 36 angel investors. Rubal Chib is innovating food quality through qZense Labs, transforming freshness and safety measurement in the supply chain.
